title: VINYL: Maybe it's time we had an intervention.
summary: Benn Jordan measures air quality around vinyl records with a pollution meter and finds high particulate and VOC levels. He argues vinyl should be modernized.
why: Cited as the source for claims that PVC records outgas harmful compounds, usually in vinyl revival threads.

quote.text: The video creator uses an air pollution meter[0] to find out that his records are causing very high PM 2.5, VOC, and formaldehyde.
